targets.Private: Product Manager, Senior Product Manager, Product Owner, Product Marketing Manager, Product Development Manager or Senior Manager, or Product Lead roles in Bangladesh. Close variants such as 'Product Manager, Payments' or 'Sr. Product Manager' count. Associate/Junior/Intern roles and Project Manager roles do not.
targets.Bank: Bank and financial-institution jobs in Bangladesh, private or state-owned, including Bangladesh Bank and Bankers' Selection Committee circulars: product, digital banking or business roles at manager level, and officer-level recruitment open to MBA graduates (for example Assistant Director, Senior Officer, Officer (General)).
targets.Government: Government, semi-government and public-sector jobs in Bangladesh open to BBA/MBA graduates at 9th grade or a similar level (for example Assistant Director, Senior Officer, Programme Officer, Assistant Manager), including BCS.
targets.Remote: Remote Product Manager, Senior Product Manager, Product Owner, Product Marketing Manager, Product Development Manager or Senior Manager, or Product Lead roles that accept candidates living in Bangladesh.
targets.Abroad: On-site or hybrid Product Manager, Senior Product Manager, Product Owner, Product Marketing Manager, Product Development Manager or Senior Manager, or Product Lead roles abroad that hire foreign nationals or offer visa sponsorship or relocation: especially the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand, Indonesia, Vietnam, Japan, Germany, the Netherlands and Ireland.
